plain_description.what: No calls. A split-half reliability check on the 20-model board: each cell's questions were split in two at random, per-model strength profiles were computed on each half, and the two were correlated (40 repeats), at subject and leaf level.
plain_description.why: It asks whether per-subject capability profiles are stable enough (bar 0.70) to publish, after the 12-model board just missed the bar (0.67).
plain_description.information: Passing allows per-subject claims on a board of this size. Failing would close that deliverable. Result: done, corrected. On the merged board subject-level reliability is 0.72, which clears the bar, but only narrowly (95% range 0.61 to 0.83). It must be published with that range. An earlier 'fail' reading on a sparser board was withdrawn. Note: older question pool, ruled 'history, not evidence'.
